items.title: Thinning revenues: inside the $14bn Eliquis patent cliff
items.summary: With $14.2bn in projected revenue losses over six years, the Eliquis LOE event is set to become one of the most consequential patent cliffs in pharmaceutical history.

items.title: EMA recommends approvals for both oral and high-dose pen of Wegovy
items.summary: The EMA’s CHMP delivered two positive opinions, which will likely see an expansion of Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy offerings in Europe.

items.title: Next-generation platforms poised to redefine crowded HAE landscape
items.summary: The HAE pharmaceutical landscape is set for unprecedented expansion as a large proportion of pipeline drugs are found in Phase III.

items.title: Eli Lilly to buy trio of vaccine developers in $3.8bn outlay
items.summary: Via the deals, Lilly is buying biotechs with lead programmes in preventing shingles, bacteria, and Epstein-Barr Virus.
